title: The absence of [C II] 158 μm emission in spectroscopically confirmed galaxies at z > 8
question: Do the two most distant spectroscopically-confirmed galaxies (z=8.38 and z=9.11), both bright in [OIII]88um, show [CII]158um emission, and what does this imply for the [CII] deficit at high redshift?

data.bands: Band 5 (new); Band 7 for YD4 re-reduced; Band 6 archival for YD4
data.sensitivity: 3sigma continuum < 21 uJy/beam (YD4), < 15 uJy/beam (JD1), not corrected for magnification

what.value: [OIII] luminosity, z, L_FIR, SFR, Mstar, 88um flux for A2744_YD4 and magnification mu=2
[OIII] luminosity, z, L_FIR, SFR, Mstar for MACS1149_JD1 and mu=10
[CII] non-detection measurements of Lyman-alpha emitter at z=7.2

evidence.quote: A similar non-detection of \[Cii\]158$\mu$m was reported by (cite: Inoue2016) for a Lyman-$\alpha$ emitter at $z$ = 7.2
lower redshift metal-poor dwarf galaxies (cite: Madden2013)

recipe.method: CASA 5.4.0 pipeline and tclean with Briggs weighting; Band 7 data for YD4 re-reduced the same way
3sigma limits from several beam-size apertures at the field centre

recipe.goal: Search for [CII] line and derive luminosity limits
recipe.method: Search in 1.5" radius circle around UV position, velocity offset ±500 km/s relative to [OIII] z, rebin to FWHM=100 km/s (also 50 km/s); rms in beam-size apertures; 3sigma L_CII limits corrected for magnification
Place sources on [CII]-SFR relation, compare [OIII]/[CII] with Katz2019 simulations and local dwarfs; select Lagache2018 analogues by SFR, L_CII and Mstar ranges
SED fit with MAGPHYS including Band 5 limit and Band 6 2sigma limit of 30 uJy/beam

evidence.quote: we find 75 simulated objects that have extreme properties similar to A2744_YD4
only 8 simulated sources have \[C II\]158$\mu$m properties similar to MACS1149_JD1

not_stated_but_needed: Briggs robust value, cell size, image size, niter and threshold
Spectral window frequencies and channel widths
Flux calibrator and flux scale uncertainty
Exact positions for the apertures and the UV-rest-frame centres
Selection details for the Lagache2018 comparison
score_reason: Public data and simple upper-limit procedure, but imaging and SED parameters are not given.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric upper limits; the recipe is simple though imaging details are missing.
